rule_text_section_4.2: stop the confirmatory framing ... if, after excluding labelled or detected system accounts and resources below the pre-registered minimum-event threshold, the median Kendall tau across defensible configurations exceeds 0.9 on both BPI 2017 and BPI 2019 and bottom-quintile reclassification under case-mix adjustment is below 10% on both; also stop if the proceedings sweep finds a rank-stability study of resource measures on public logs.
